cannabis.text: Pellerin authored AB 1111, which would let small licensed cannabis cultivators sell their products directly at state-approved temporary events.
cannabis.quote: The bill would authorize a licensee who holds a valid annual state cultivation license and a valid license, permit, or other authorization for cannabis cultivation issued by a local jurisdiction, and who meets specified other requirements, to apply for a small producer event sales license.

energy.text: Pellerin scored 98% on the 2025 California Environmental Scorecard and received extra credit for authoring or principal-coauthoring a scorecard climate bill.
energy.quote: This representative received extra credit for the following: Being an author or principal coauthor of a Scorecard bill.

voting.text: Pellerin, a former county elections official and chair of the Assembly Elections Committee, praised a ruling requiring mail ballots postmarked by Election Day to be counted and said voters should not lose their voices to mail delays.
voting.quote: Eligible voters who did everything the law required should not have their voices silenced because of mail processing changes or mail delays beyond their control.

tax.text: Pefley lists lowering the cost of living through tax relief among her key campaign priorities.
tax.quote: Advocate for tax relief and policies that make housing and essential goods more affordable for all Californians.

housing.text: Pefley opposes state housing mandates and overdevelopment, favoring locally controlled, coordinated growth.
housing.quote: I believe in responsible, coordinated growth that works with communities, not sweeping mandates that override local planning.
